tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return one whole document, exactly as the site publishes it, by name: developers, agent-guide, auth-md, llms, developers-llms, openapi, pricing, corporate, about, privacy, terms, glossary; or resources/<slug> for a library article and resources/glossary/<slug> for a glossary term (the document names search_docs returns).

name.description: The document's name: a site document (developers, agent-guide, auth-md, llms, developers-llms, openapi, pricing, corporate, about, privacy, terms or glossary), resources/<slug> for a library article, or resources/glossary/<slug> for a glossary term.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Australia Wide First Aid's documentation by keyword: the developer portal, agent guide, auth.md, llms.txt files, pricing, corporate, about, privacy and terms pages, and the first aid library's article and glossary titles and summaries. Returns up to five sections, best first, each with its heading, document name, page URL and text; empty when nothing matches. Use get_doc for a whole document.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words (at most 200 characters), such as api key, refund or CPR.
